We have created the world’s most comprehensive digital science platform – best-of-breed software applications already used by more than 2 million scientists, together in a single ecosystem united by a powerful, flexible enterprise data platform. This is not flat data buried away in digital graveyards. This is dynamic, multi-dimensional decision-making.

Scientific enterprises need a new level of effectiveness to achieve tomorrow’s breakthroughs. Illness will not wait. The biosphere will not wait. We are tireless in our vision, because the time for innovation is now.

Shaping the Future of Science At Dotmatics 

Our global team of more than 800 colleagues are dedicated to supporting our customers in over 180 countries. Together, with our scientific community of users, we accelerate scientific innovation in order to make the world a healthier, cleaner, and safer place to live.

You’ll join a collaborative, global team pushing the boundaries of scientific innovation.  Your ideas and efforts will have a tangible impact, accelerating scientific progress and discovery. We offer a dynamic, remote-friendly environment that fosters high integrity and collaboration, empowering you to excel. Dotmatics is a company built by scientists, for scientists. Combined, we are now the world’s largest cloud-based scientific research R&D platform. We need your help to keep growing and pioneering the future.

We are Science Driven. We are Customer Centric. We are Better Together. 

What do we need

Scientists are solving some of the hardest problems in the world. Your job is to make sure they find the tools that help them do it. 

As a Solution Marketing Manager at Dotmatics, you'll work at the center of science and communication, deeply understanding how researchers in your application area think, what they're trying to accomplish, and what gets in their way. You'll translate that understanding into stories, campaigns, and content that connect scientists with the right solutions at the right moment. 

From a product perspective, Luma and ELN are your primary vehicles. Both require messaging that works at the enterprise level and resonates with specific scientific audiences. Dotmatics also has a broad portfolio of specialized products, each with their own dedicated marketers. Your job is not to own those products, but to connect them into compelling solution narratives when they're relevant to your audience and use case. 

We're looking for someone who is genuinely curious about how scientists work, who loves the challenge of making complex ideas land, and who finds real satisfaction in building something from the ground up. If that sounds like you, we'd love to talk. 

In this role you will get to: 

  • Own the positioning, messaging, and content development for your scientific application area: personas, use cases, value propositions, differentiation, and collateral.
  • Develop strategic campaign briefs that translate positioning into actionable guidance for demand generation and integrated marketing.
  • Build and maintain sales enablement materials that help the Dotmatics commercial team have better conversations, including pitch frameworks, solution narratives, objection handling, and competitive context.
  • Partner with the wider marketing team to deliver the message to the market.
  • Engage directly with internal subject matter experts and customers to gather insights and shape strategy.
  • Act as the voice of your scientific audience across marketing and sales, influencing decisions and building alignment across senior stakeholders. 

We are looking for people who have 5+ years in a role where science and communication intersect: marketing, field applications, science communications, or similar, ideally in life sciences or research software. 

  • Scientific grounding to have credible conversations with researchers. A degree in a relevant discipline can be a real advantage here, and relevant hands-on experience is equally welcome.
  • A track record of taking something complicated and making it click for an audience who didn't have time to become an expert.
  • You've had the chance to build something from scratch before, and you want to do it again.
  • You're comfortable working across functions and influencing without direct authority. 

Research shows us the confidence gap and imposter syndrome can get in the way of meeting outstanding candidates, so please don’t hesitate to apply — we’d love to hear from you.

By submitting your application, you agree that Dotmatics may collect your personal data for recruiting, global organization planning, and related purposes. Dotmatics Privacy Notice explains what personal information we may process, where we may process your personal information, our purposes for processing your personal information, and the rights you can exercise over Dotmatics use of your personal information.

Fondsmanager und Fondsadministratoren in ganz Europa wickeln über Vestlane ihre KYC-, AML- und Zeichnungsprozesse ab, in über 14 Jurisdiktionen und über den gesamten Investor-Lifecycle hinweg. Wir sind zertifiziert und für die regulatorische Realität spannender Akronyme gebaut – von GwG, BaFin, AMLR, RTS, CSSF bis hin zu DORA, RAIF, AIFMD, MiFID uvm. Du machst seit Jahren fundierte und pragmatische KYC- und AML-Arbeit und bist bereit, mehr zu verantworten, als die Karriereleiter über dir zulässt? Du möchtest mit modernen Tools und KI am Puls der Zeit in einem dynamischen Team arbeiten? Dann ist diese Rolle für dich! “KYC/AML Services” ist Vestlanes jüngstes Team, das die operative KYC- und AML-Arbeit für Fonds- und Asset Manager-Kunden in Deutschland, Großbritannien und Luxemburg erbringt. Du arbeitest direkt mit unserem Head of KYC & AML Operations zusammen und übernimmst echte Verantwortung ab Tag eins und hast direkten Investoren- und Kundenkontakt. Deinen Entwicklungspfad gestaltest du aktiv mit, erfolgsabhängig, statt getrieben vom nächsten Beförderungszyklus. Deine Aufgaben Investorenakten von A bis Z: Du führst KYC-Prüfungen, Risikobewertungen und Enhanced Due Diligence für Investoren und Assets in Fondsstrukturen in Deutschland, Großbritannien und Luxemburg durch – mithilfe unserer KI-gestützten, digitalen Plattform. Screening-Treffer bearbeiten: Du bewertest und dokumentierst Treffer aus Namens-, Sanktions- und Adverse-Media-Screening und bereitest klare, entscheidungsreife Bewertungen vor – mithilfe nativer KI-Agenten. Geldwäschebeauftragte der Kunden unterstützen: Du erstellst Eskalationsvermerke und Reportings, damit Geldwäschebeauftragte und Responsables du Contrôle unserer Kunden auf solider Grundlage entscheiden können. Die Maschine mitbauen: Du wirkst an Policies, Checklisten, QA-Standards und Tooling unserer Abteilung aktiv mit. Du hinterfragst kritisch, denkst Prozesse neu. Du willst KYC/AML als Geschäftschance verstehen und nicht als Last. Das Produkt verbessern: Du zeigst auf, wo die Vestlane-Plattform KYC-Arbeit schneller und sicherer machen kann, und setzt das gemeinsam mit unserem Produktteam um. Dein Profil Mindestens 3 Jahre operative KYC/AML- oder vergleichbare Erfahrung, etwa bei einer Big-4- oder Wirtschaftsprüfungsgesellschaft, einem Fondsadministrator, einer KYC/AML-Beratung oder in der AML-Funktion eines Fonds oder Finanzinstituts. Sichere Kenntnisse des deutschen und des Luxemburger Rechtsrahmens: GwG und BaFin-Auslegungspraxis auf der einen Seite, CSSF-Anforderungen und das Luxemburger AML-Gesetz auf der anderen. Du kennst beide Welten und weißt, wo sie sich unterscheiden. UK-Erfahrung ist ein Plus. Erfahrung mit Fondsstrukturen und ihren Investoren (Institutionelle Anleger, Gesellschaften, Trusts, verschachtelte UBO-Ketten). Private-Markets-Erfahrung ist ein starkes Plus. Zertifizierungen (z. B. ACAMS, ICA) sind willkommen, keine Voraussetzung. Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch und Englisch. Französisch hilft in Luxemburg, ist aber keine Bedingung. Präzision und Urteilsvermögen: Du dokumentierst sauber, eskalierst im richtigen Moment und willst, dass deine Arbeit jeder Prüfung standhält. Gleichzeitig bist du pragmatisch, du weißt, dass Risiko aus “Impact” und “Likelihood” besteht. Du siehst dich als Unternehmer innerhalb von Vestlane, nicht als reiner Checklisten-Abhaker. Du willst heute Verantwortung und morgen Führung, und du willst dir beides erarbeiten, indem du etwas aufbaust. Benefits bei Vestlane Teammitglied mit klarem Entwicklungspfad, wenn der Kundenstamm wächst Direkter Kundenkontakt ab Tag eins, keine fünf Ebenen zwischen dir und den Menschen, für die deine Arbeit zählt Kompetitives Gehaltspaket 30 Tage Urlaub Bezahlte Weiterbildungen und Zertifizierungen (z. B. ACAMS, ICA) Büro in Bonn Flexiblen Arbeitszeiten und Home-Office-Regelungen Ein Team, das Compliance ernst nimmt, weil Compliance das Produkt ist, kein Kostenfaktor Abschluss Wir freuen uns auf deinen Lebenslauf und ein aussagekräftiges Anschreiben. Wir prüfen deine Bewerbung persönlich und melden uns innerhalb von zwei Wochen. Der Prozess ist bewusst kurz und hat drei Schritte: ein 30-minütiges Kennenlerngespräch, in dem es um dich, deinen Weg und die Frage geht, ob wir zueinander passen. Dann ein 45-minütiger Termin mit einer praktischen Aufgabe aus dem echten Alltag der Abteilung, damit du siehst, was dich erwartet, und wir sehen, wie du arbeitest. Zum Abschluss ein 30-minütiges Gespräch mit der Geschäftsführung. Insgesamt weniger als zwei Stunden deiner Zeit, und du bekommst nach jedem Schritt zeitnah Rückmeldung. Fragen vor der Bewerbung? Melde dich bei uns! Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Environmental Test Laboratory Manager
description: About Us Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces. Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected. About the Role As Validation Laboratory Module Lead , you build Harmattan's environmental test laboratory from a blank page and then run it. Today too much of our environmental testing depends on external labs and their scheduling, which slows our development down as much as it costs us. Your mission is to change that, and you own it end to end: defining the capabilities we need, specifying and buying the machines, contributing to the choice of premises, recruiting and leading the technicians, and drawing the line between what we bring in-house and what stays external. This is a senior, hands-on leadership role, and the lab does not exist yet. Beyond building it, you become the Group's reference on environmental testing: supporting the validation teams on the lab validation of their projects, reviewing the environmental parts of their test plans, and handing our test procedures over to the quality team as products move into production. What you'll do Define the lab and select the equipment: Establish the capabilities we need, then specify, evaluate and procure the machines, covering climatic and thermal cycling, water and dust ingress, vibration and UV ageing, including a large climate room in which we can fly a drone under controlled wind and temperature. Decide what we internalise and what stays external: Draw the line between the tests worth owning and those better bought from external labs, such as accredited qualification or rare capital-heavy tests, and revisit that line as our product range grows. Set up the facility: Contribute to the choice of premises, then take the site from layout and utilities through to installation, safety and commissioning. Build and lead the team: Recruit and lead a team of two to three lab technicians, set the working standards, and grow the team's capability as the lab ramps up. Support the validation teams: Assist the validation modules on the lab validation of their projects, and peer-review the environmental sections of their test plans, making sure the right tests, conditions and acceptance criteria are defined. Hand over to production: Work with the quality team to transfer our test procedures as products reach PVT and mass production, so that production-line testing stays consistent with what validation defined. What we're looking for At least 10 years in environmental testing , including setting up or substantially developing a test lab. This is a senior role and we are looking for depth, not a first lab job. Strong command of environmental test methods and the equipment behind them: climatic and thermal cycling, vibration, water and dust ingress, UV, and the standards that frame them. Proven equipment judgement: able to specify, evaluate and procure test machines, and to argue build-versus-buy and in-house-versus-external on both cost and technical merit. Experience leading a small technical team, or clear readiness to step into that responsibility. A rigorous, methodical approach to test planning, acceptance criteria and documentation. Comfortable working across functions with engineering, validation and quality, and translating between them. Engineering degree in a relevant field (mechanical, materials, electronics, physics or similar), or equivalent experience. Bonus: experience with defence or aerospace test standards (MIL-STD-810, RTCA DO-160 or similar); familiarity with lab accreditation and metrological traceability such as ISO/IEC 17025; a background in drones or robotics. Working-level English; French is a plus. Based at our Paris-area site, with occasional travel to our Swiss site. We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI. Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Medical Science Liaison
description:
The Medical Science Liaison (MSL) is a field-based scientific expert responsible for engaging healthcare providers, generating insights, and supporting Medical Affairs priorities across Natera’s oncology portfolio, including our personalized minimal residual disease (MRD) testing. This role focuses on building strong scientific relationships, delivering clear and accurate education, and bringing back actionable insights from the field. You will own your territory, make decisions independently, and deliver clear clinical data to providers to help them make better-informed decisions.

Territory: North Texas, Arkansas, Omaha

 

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Establish and maintain scientific relationships with healthcare providers and key opinion leaders (KOLs) within a defined territory.

  • Deliver accurate, balanced, and clinically relevant education on Natera’s oncology products and data.

  • Deliver on territory plans aligned to Medical Affairs priorities.

  • Identify and communicate field insights, including treatment trends, unmet needs, and competitive dynamics.

  • Respond to unsolicited medical inquiries in a timely, compliant, and scientifically rigorous manner.

  • Support execution of Medical Affairs initiatives including advisory boards and medical education programs.

  • Maintain a strong understanding of disease states, clinical data, and the evolving oncology landscape.

  • Collaborate directly with Sales, Marketing, and R&D to move work forward without relying on rigid processes.

  • Maintain medical independence and strict compliance, always keeping the patient at the center of your work.

  • Support and coordinate clinical trial and research initiatives at academic institutions and study sites.

  • Meet all metrics as assigned and complete appropriate documentation and tracking of field visits, insights, and research opportunities.

  • Travel extensively (over 60%) as required.

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Advanced healthcare/scientific degree preferred (Ph.D., Pharm.D, M.D., D.N.P.). Master’s degree required.

  • Diagnostic, IVD, or device experience preferred.

  • Must live within the assigned territory.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES:

  • Clear communicator and independent thinker.

  • Ability to work remotely while maintaining a strong teamwork ethic.

  • Make evidence-based decisions quickly and operate with urgency to get meaningful products to clinicians without compromising quality.

  • Use strategic thinking to contribute to product, departmental, and organizational plans and goals.

  • Adapt quickly when priorities shift and solve problems rather than waiting for structure.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to read, interpret, and convey complex scientific information.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS & WORK ENVIRONMENT:

  • Remote position requiring frequent sitting, standing, walking, and daily computer use.

  • Extensive travel required.

  • Requires the ability to communicate over the telephone and read printed material.

  • Duties may require working outside normal working hours (evenings and weekends).

At DataSnipper, we build AI solutions that empower those professionals. By making evidence easier to trace and verify, we help them focus on the judgment and expertise that make their work so important. We've just launched a brand new agentic platform, Alwin by DataSnipper. AI agents running in the cloud across hundreds of documents at once, reasoning across PDF, Word and Excel, with a full audit trail behind every step. There are lots of greenfield problems ahead, and real room to shape what we build and how we build it. And we build at scale. title: Allied Health: Respiratory Therapist Clinical Content Reviewer (Part-time, Remote, PRN Position)
description:
Position Overview 

We are seeking Registered Respiratory Therapists to serve as Subject Matter Experts for an AI-powered learning platform supporting learners preparing for respiratory therapy credentialing and practice. 

Primary Responsibilities 

  • Evaluate AI-generated content related to cardiopulmonary anatomy and physiology, patient assessment, airway management, oxygen and aerosol therapy, mechanical ventilation, arterial blood gas interpretation, pulmonary function testing, and respiratory pharmacology 
  • Review content on neonatal, pediatric, and adult critical care respiratory management and common cardiopulmonary disease states 
  • Apply structured evaluation metrics to score accuracy, completeness, and clinical applicability 
  • Provide expert feedback to improve clarity, safety, and educational value for respiratory therapy learners 
  • Complete asynchronous evaluations within defined timelines (5 days to 2 weeks) 
  • Participate in periodic evaluation cycles with potential for ad-hoc assignments 

Required Qualifications 

  • Current Registered Respiratory Therapist (RRT) credential through the National Board for Respiratory Care (NBRC) 
  • Active state respiratory care license (where required by state) in good standing 
  • Graduate of a CoARC-accredited respiratory therapy program (minimum associate degree) 
  • Minimum of 2 years of clinical experience 

Preferred Qualifications 

  • Experience in respiratory therapy education, clinical preceptorship, or content review 
  • NBRC specialty credential (e.g., NPS, ACCS, SDS) or experience in critical care, neonatal/pediatric, or pulmonary diagnostics 
  • Familiarity with the NBRC TMC and Clinical Simulation exam content outlines 

Time Commitment 

5–15 hours/week (Minimum quarterly participation) 

Project Details  

  • Duration: 1 year contract (subject to annual renewal) starting ASAP
  • Compensation: $55/hr 
  • Contract Structure: W2 position contracted through a 3rd party agency
